title: Paper vs digital owner manual
summary: Reviews focus on the absence of a printed owner manual, the use of digital or online documentation, and a few mentions comparing automatic and manual driving.

positive.summary: Positive comments praise the automatic gearbox compared with manual driving rather than the owner documentation itself.

negative.summary: Negative comments criticize the lack of a proper paper manual and the inconvenience of having setup information only on the in-car display.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention wanting or expecting a paper manual, asking where the manual is, or referring to the manual without a clear evaluative stance.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment evidence is limited.
The topic cluster mixes owner-manual/documentation comments with a few references to manual versus automatic transmission, so not all mentions concern the same subject.
Only a small set of example fragments is available, so examples are insufficient to fully characterize all reviews in the topic.
